summary: One-line fix replaces `self.queryset.none()` with `self.queryset.model.objects.none()`, correctly returning an empty queryset for combined queries (union/intersection/difference) where `.none()` is a no-op. Matches Django's actual merged fix for this issue; minimal and correct.

issues.description: Root cause is that QuerySet.none() silently returns all rows on combined queries; patching the caller resolves the form symptom but the underlying QuerySet behavior remains. Acceptable and standard fix scope, but a maintainer may note it treats the symptom site rather than the query layer.
